cohort.fullPlayLimit: PlaySim.run owns the engine natural finish/timeout; no collector override

definitions.retainedOriginalHelperRecord: Original installed members[1], still in its unreleased original combination and no physical engagement, with retained shared-bookkeeping advancement OR actual own consumed owner+DL images OR actual check-climb event. Quiet private checks may not be retained; this is not a count of every private check/cadence call.
definitions.installedScope: Inside/split zone inferred from the fixed initial call and installed member roles. The unchanged collector does not record new helpRule metadata, and this report does not assert full equality of unrecorded new policy fields.
definitions.checkClimb: Actual block_climb event with check-prefixed detail during a free-original-helper update, naming that helper/backer, plus native combo-check-climb tag and released old combination. Final whole-update work is separate: ordinary later retargeting can change it, so a climb/backer final plan is not required.
definitions.ownerSecurity: Conservative clamped-urgency descriptive threshold e.control>-.072, baseB>.60, |phi|<.55; -.072 is the largest ordinary threshold over mind urgency range[.1,.95]. Exact current observer urgency is absent. Native owner hands, support availability and outsiders recorded separately.
definitions.ownCue: Owner/DL/backer/RB images actually consumed by this helper in the update. Filling/arriving are computed for each recorded backer/RB image using the ordinary4.2yd and LOS−2.8 predicates. Presence alone does not assign the image to a particular private method.
definitions.observedGeometry: Visible surface fit/current corridor computed only for unambiguous consumed owner/DL/backer pictures. Installed home/side derive from original saved body positions; measured arm yards invert saved profile.reach via pinned physical.ts. Private checkNextRead is absent, so only dt0 corridor is reproduced; the controller’s future projection is explicitly unmeasured. Neither legacy shared nextRead nor initial decisionInterval supplies the actual private interval.
definitions.stability: Private helper checkSince/checkNextRead are not recorded by this collector; exact states/reset/dwell/cadence/future projection need independent tests/source review. Only retained actual cue/event records are counted.
definitions.keeper: Actual live owner hand joint before departure compared by per-play ID after controller and next native solve. Contact/control/drive/surface snapshots and solved loads are independent of job labels.
definitions.climbFollowup: New climb labels separated from later actual backer body contacts, live hand joints, positive native hand force and target changes. Uses unchanged per-OL first contact/hands metrics plus all retained solved loads/ownership changes. Absence means no recorded confirmation, not proof a runner-free future lane was successfully blocked or that no unretained body touch occurred.
definitions.joinedPhaseControl: Previously adverse Split/Bear R S11 compares exact public result, whole-play OL metrics and both actual joined-climb timestamps/member plans/contact state/native solved loads. Only tags are removed from the explicitly scoped joined-climb projection; false whole-execution signature is retained, not relabelled a fully identical execution.
definitions.nativeUnits: Force kg·yd/s², impulse kg·yd/s, work kg·yd²/s²; SI force/impulse ×0.9144, work ×0.9144².
definitions.retainedScope: Native OL limits cover retained controller ticks; global work/momentum residuals were recorded at every solved tick. No full nativeRecord duplication in this summary.

limitations: Balanced160 with one generated roster pair31/32 is not an NFL success-rate/concept-distribution target. Two roster41/42 recovery witnesses remain separate.

The saved initial projection omits newly added helper-policy metadata/private stability/cadence state. Initial physical/profile/plan projections match exactly; source/tests establish new rule defaults and scope.

Quiet helper checks can be omitted by the unchanged collector. Actual observed check records and emitted climbs are not a complete policy-call population; private future corridor sampling cannot be reconstructed exactly from legacy shared cadence.
The full pre-update World joint list is absent; a missing RunBlocker engagement does not by itself prove the helper has no grasp/press joint. That exclusion needs independent source/tests.
Consumed images elsewhere in the same update may come from crossing-threat or ordinary approach rules; they are not automatically labelled a check-policy cue.
A mechanically feasible helper departure can improve or worsen a later coupled football outcome; all paired and adverse outcomes remain visible.
First-contact metrics keep only the first contact for each player pair; later pair contacts before a retained row may be absent. No-recorded-contact is therefore distinct from a proven miss.
No fresh perception calls, body parking, fabricated gains, global resolution changes or runtime-speed claims are introduced by comparison.
